github.description: GitHub operations — PRs, issues, repos, code search. Requires GITHUB_TOKEN env var (a GitHub PAT). For OAuth or local Docker alternatives see github.com/github/github-mcp-server.

filesystem.description: Local file system access — scoped to project root. No auth required.

context7.description: Live library documentation lookup. Add 'use context7' to your prompt to fetch current API docs. No auth required.

sequential-thinking.description: Structured chain-of-thought reasoning for complex planning and architectural decisions. No auth required.

_disabled_postgres.description: DISABLED — rename to 'postgres' to enable. PostgreSQL read access. NOTE: this npm package is deprecated/unsupported upstream; consider a maintained Postgres MCP server. Requires DATABASE_URL env var.

_disabled_jira.description: DISABLED — rename to 'jira' to enable. Read/create/update Jira issues. Requires JIRA_URL, JIRA_EMAIL, JIRA_API_TOKEN env vars. Install uvx: pip install uv

_disabled_playwright.description: DISABLED — rename to 'playwright' to enable. Browser automation for E2E testing — pairs with /e2e command. No auth required.
